# TaskSetMaxTimeSlice

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Sets the longest timeslice a task may give itself; shortens its current slice if needed.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x0C` SVC_MANAGETASK | `MNGTASK_SET_MAX_TIMESLICE (9)` | no | 2.0 |

```c
Err TaskSetMaxTimeSlice(Handle h, uint32_t max_us);
```

**Registers:** `(task, max_us) -> r0 status`

New tasks inherit their creator's maximum. Like TaskSetMaxPriority(), a task can only hand out a maximum up to its own.

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `h` | in | Task handle with PERM_CNTL, or -1 for the caller. |
| `max_us` | in | New maximum in microseconds, within [TIMESLICE_MIN_US, TIMESLICE_MAX_US]. |

## Returns

ZUZU_OK, or an error code.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../errors.md#err_badarg) | `max_us` is out of range. |
| [`ERR_NOPERM`](../errors.md#err_noperm) | `max_us` is above the caller's own maximum, or `h` lacks PERM_CNTL. |
| [`ERR_BADHANDLE`](../errors.md#err_badhandle) | `h` is not a live handle. |
| [`ERR_BADTYPE`](../errors.md#err_badtype) | `h` is not a task. |
